technical.summary: Short-term momentum is strong with elevated volume and rising RSI, but overbought conditions, weak trend structure (low ADX), and price below key moving averages limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AAL shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 9 days create elevated volatility risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (32/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (281+ days old) with only junior-level small sales; no recent news sentiment available to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (359.68), flat yield curve recession signal, rising dollar headwind, imminent CPI event (1 day), and earnings in 9 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for AAL.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (32/100) with 15x volume spike, rising RSI momentum, and bullish OBV/Force Index create a contrarian buy setup near support (13.17) in a capitulation environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Imminent earnings (9 days), VIX crisis regime (359.68), price below all key moving averages, weak ADX trend confirmation (22.64), overbought stochRSI/Williams %R, and unfavorable macro (CPI in 1 day, flat yield curve, rising dollar) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear (32/100) and 15x volume spike create contrarian appeal with price at support (13.17), the combination of imminent earnings (9 days), VIX crisis regime (359.68), and price below all key moving averages presents unacceptable risk/reward for a swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 9 days combined with macro crisis conditions (VIX 359.68, CPI in 1 day, flat yield curve) creates binary event risk that invalidates technical setup and can gap through support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk despite technical momentum
decision.portfolio_note: Already 28 positions in Industrials sector; adding AAL increases concentration risk in unfavorable macro environment without fundamental or institutional conviction.
